2607.16062.title: When Model Merging Rivals Joint Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning: A Task-Vector Geometry Analysis
2607.16062.paper_summary: Model merging is promoted as a substitute for joint multi-task training, yet in the reinforcement-learning setting this substitution is essentially never tested against the baseline it claims to replace: methods merge independently released agents precisely because a joint model is unavailable. We build the missing comparison. Training difficulty-1 and difficulty-2 Qwen3-8B specialists on the AppWorld agent benchmark with LOOP, we merge them (TIES, RAM+) and pit the result against a jointly trained model on the same data. On task-goal completion, merging matches joint RL -- and every merge variant is statistically indistinguishable. To explain why merge method does not matter here, we measure the geometry of the specialists' task vectors, which carries no task-sampling noise: they are near-orthogonal (cosine 0.06 - 0.10) despite ~65% support overlap, a small, shared direction that grows over training and that we calibrate against a random-init floor and a same-run ceiling to confirm it reflects learning, not the low-rank parameterization. Because direction and support are decoupled, support and sign-based merging (RAM, TIES) collapse to near-uniform averaging. We release all code and statistics.
2607.16062.paper_summary_zh: 模型合併被推廣作為聯合多任務訓練的替代方案，然而在強化學習的環境中，這種替代方案基本上從未與其聲稱要取代的基準進行測試：方法獨立合併釋放的代理，正是因為聯合模型不可用。我們建立了缺失的比較。使用 LOOP 在 AppWorld 代理基準上訓練難度-1 和難度-2 的 Qwen3-8B 專家，我們將它們合併（TIES, RAM+）並將結果與在相同數據上聯合訓練的模型進行對比。在任務目標完成方面，合併的表現與聯合強化學習相匹配——而且每個合併變體在統計上無法區分。為了解釋為什麼合併方法在這裡不重要，我們測量專家的任務向量的幾何形狀，這不帶有任務取樣噪聲：儘管約有65%的支持重疊，它們幾乎是正交的（餘弦 0.06 - 0.10），這是一個隨著訓練增長的小型共享方向，我們將其與隨機初始化的下限和同次運行的上限進行校準，以確認它反映的是學習，而非低秩參數化。由於方向和支持是解耦的，基於支持和符號的合併（RAM, TIES）會收斂為近似均勻的平均。我們釋放所有代碼和統計數據。
2607.16062.author: S. Aaron McClendon et.al.
